scope: Configuration surface inventory; CLI options are extracted from the local parser without dispatching commands. Constants are code limits, not necessarily operator settings. No runtime tokens or user configuration values are included.

orphan_claim.summary: reassign a dead lane's orphaned claim

closed_claim.summary: end a claim whose issue a merged pull request closed

idle_key.summary: release a key its idle holder never uses

failed_ci.summary: re-run a failed CI job once
